pages.markdown:
Running a wholesale distributor or builders’ merchant today
means tighter margins, higher customer expectations, and
constant pressure to work faster. ERP One is built for your
industry, for you to stay ahead.
E R P  O n e  i s  the market-leading enterprise solution trusted by
thousands of distributors and builders’ merchants to operate
efficiently, scale faster, and protect margins across their branch
and distribution centre networks.
Built specifically for the industry, it unifies sales, purchasing,
inventory, finance, fulfilment, and business intelligence into one
powerful cloud-based platform.
ERP One gives you complete visibility and control across your
business. This means smoother operations, stronger margins,
faster growth, and more time to focus on running your business.

pages.markdown:
We were on a legacy ERP system that was out of life. Klipboard was the unanimous winner.
They have the industry knowledge. The product has to deal with the specialist areas that we
have within our industry, which Klipboard provides with ERP One. When we upgrade, we don’t
have to do customisations, so the upgrade path in the future is a lot smoother. It modernises
that process and makes people productive from day one.
G r a h a m  E c c l e s ,  F i n a n c e  D i r e c t o r  a t  B S S
Customer
Success with
ERP One: B S S
BSS Industrial is a British
specialist distributor of heating,
ventilation, pipeline and
mechanical services equipment,
operating across the country.
With 52 branches and two national
distribution centres, BSS (part of the Travis
Perkins Group) operates in a market where
complex pricing and time-critical deliveries
are the norm. However, their legacy
business system limited visibility and
slowed decision-making.
To stay competitive, BSS chose ERP One.
Working with Klipboard, they delivered a
phased rollout and became the first
customer to use ERP One’s webhooks for
seamless integration.Following a successful pilot, the system
went live across all sites.
Since deployment, BSS has transformed
operations with:
Faster customer service at trade
counters
New starters onboarded in days
instead of months
Automated pricing and rebates with
real-time margin visibility
A scalable platform ready for future
digital innovation
BSS continues to invest in its Klipboard
ecosystem, with mobile and automation
tools on the horizon, building on ERP One
to drive the next phase of digital growth
and reinforce its industry leadership.
W a t c h  t h e  s t o r y
